keyFindings.description: This is a semantic conflict with main that no text merge shows. Since #2368 and #2390, main's store.ConnectionsPerProcess (pool.go:312 on main) is the sum of every pool the server opens, and gcp's dispatchConnectionsPerPod (infra/gcp/dispatch.go:97, now 86) must equal it, because the pair sizes the Cloud SQL max_connections budget for every pod during a roll. main's comment says a new pool goes into ConnectionsPerProcess with it. This PR adds the 2-connection horizon pool (horizonPoolSize), and the merged tree counts it in neither constant, so each pod can open 2 more connections than the budget allows. Fix: forward-merge main, add horizonPoolSize to ConnectionsPerProcess, and raise dispatchConnectionsPerPod by 2.
